Thus crime: production? No, distribution/sale of pornographic materials. In Chinese criminal law, the crime is "传播淫秽物品罪" (selling pornographic materials). In examples, they used "传播性病" as a crime. For pornographic disc sale, they might label as "传播淫秽物品". The answer format: [罪名]传播淫秽物品<eoa>.
